content.short: Layer 3 is a gamified Web3 education platform with bounty checkpoints that award XP for community building.
content.description: Layer 3 is a gamified Web3 education platform that helps people discover and learn about Web3. Checkpoints are presented as bounties, serving as XP that supports community-building activities. The platform delivers an interactive learning journey designed to build knowledge across the Web3 landscape, from foundational concepts to more advanced topics. Its goal is to foster lifelong education within Web3 communities and to help users connect with like-minded members, or find their tribe, as they grow their understanding of the space.
content.meta: Layer 3 is a gamified Web3 education platform for discovering and learning about Web3. Discover Layer 3 and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
